broker.about: Global Prime says it has operated since 2010. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard and Raw. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 5. The site names these regulators: ASIC and VFSC. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. A minimum deposit figure on the site is 0 USD. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, regulation, about, contact, and account-type pages loaded. About page states Global Prime was founded in 2010 and opened to retail clients in 2011. Contact page gives a South Yarra address for FMGP Trading Group Pty Ltd but does not call it headquarters. Homepage says client funds are segregated with tier-1 banks like HSBC. About page says client money is held at National Australia Bank. About page also says the VFSC entity may use client money for hedging and that there is no deposit compensation scheme for that entity. The same AFSL 385620 and Vanuatu company number 40256 are also published on Fusion Markets pages.
